description: §21.3 / §41.3.1 — `JwtError` is declared in the submodule `scrml:auth/jwt` and NOT re-exported by `scrml:auth`, so `import { JwtError } from 'scrml:auth'` fires E-IMPORT-004 (the message points at `scrml:auth/jwt`).
rationale: A module's exports are what it declares or re-exports by name; a name only a submodule exports is not exported by the umbrella module. §21.3 E-IMPORT-004 applies to `scrml:` imports per §41.3.1.
